subject: Recap + next steps: LedgerBox inference economics & pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <t.harris@ledgerbox.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next steps: LedgerBox inference economics & pilot

Hi Tom / Amrita —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap from our side to confirm we heard you correctly and to put proposed next steps in one place. Happy to fold in anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Current cost per inference (text-gen) is rising unpredictably as volume spikes; Ops lacks visibility into per-route unit economics.
- Heavy tail of long-sequence requests (20–40% at >1k tokens) causing GPU memory pressure and higher per-token costs.
- Cache misses across routes since you can’t safely reuse prefixes between customer flows.

Current stack and constraints:
- Inference self-hosted on GCP (A2s / A100 fleet), using a mixture of open LLMs and a small finetuned decoder model.
- Running synchronous endpoints with limited batching (per-team microservices).
- Security: must remain within VPC; SOC2 + audit logs are required for pilot.

Success criteria you called out (what will make this successful):
1) 30–40% reduction in per-token spend for retail routing at equivalent latency SLOs, or clear ops savings if latency increases slightly;
2) End-to-end profiling (first-10k requests) showing batching/caching gains;
3) A 3-week pilot with predictable rollback and SLA for availability during the pilot window.

Openness to optimization levers:
- Quantization: you said your infra team is open to 4-bit/8-bit quantization trials as long as quality regressions are measured against a small test-set.
- Batching/caching: strong interest in automated prefix caching and workload-aware batching, but pilot must include guardrails for high-priority low-latency routes.

Proposed next steps (my suggestions):
1) We’ll send a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a short SOW + pilot pricing sheet.
2) You to share a redacted sample of 1–2k inference logs and a brief list of the top 3 latency-sensitive routes (attachment guide: sample-inference-logs.json).
3) Align on pilot kickoff window — suggested dates the week of Jan 18, 2027.
4) Internal call with your infra/security and our Private deployment SME to confirm VPC & KMS requirements (30–45 min).

Attachments: LB-MAP-draft.pdf (pilot scope), sample-inference-logs.json (log format example).

If that matches, I’ll circulate the MAP + pricing proposal by EOD tomorrow and we can target a short sync to finalize the SOW.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — production LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Tom Harris <t.harris@ledgerbox.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amrita Sen <amrita.sen@ledgerbox.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: LedgerBox inference economics & pilot

Neha —

Thanks for the crisp recap; that tracks well. Couple clarifications from our side:
- The 30–40% target is our target on net per-token cost after including infra and egress — if you can get us to the low end of that we’ll be very happy.
- For quantization, our QA lead wants a quality gate (BLEU/ROUGE-style + manual spot checks) — happy to provide the eval set.
- Pilot length: we prefer 3 weeks with a 1-week measurement/validation window afterwards.

We’ll push a redacted sample of ~2k logs and a short list of the top routes by Wednesday, Dec 30.

For kickoff: Jan 19 or Jan 20 works for us.

Also please include a rough expected monthly run-rate for the pilot (GPU hours / unit estimate) in the pricing sheet so procurement has something to model.

Tom Harris
Head of Platform Engineering | LedgerBox
t.harris@ledgerbox.com | +1 312-555-0142
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <t.harris@ledgerbox.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: LedgerBox inference economics & pilot

Tom —

Appreciate the quick reply and the clarity on measurement gates. Attached is an updated MAP and a pricing model workbook (pricing-model-proposal.xlsx) with a pilot estimate line that includes expected GPU-hours and projected per-token spend for the configurations we discussed (baseline, 8-bit quant, 4-bit + aggressive batching).

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll schedule a 30-min intro with our Private deployments SME and SRE for Jan 19 at 11am PT — saving the calendar hold until you confirm.
- We’ll also attach a short eval template you can use for the QA checks (BLEU/spot-check checklist).
- Please confirm whether procurement needs a PO or a signed SOW before we start the pilot; if DocuSign is preferred we can send the SOW that way.

Doc links / artifacts: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/LB-2026-109 (deal record), https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAPDraft (MAP draft).

If Jan 19/20 looks good I’ll lock the kickoff and send the calendar invite.

Best,
Neha

Attachment stubs:
- pricing-model-proposal.xlsx (pilot estimator - sheets: baseline / quant / batching)
- LB-MAP-draft.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: LedgerBox — pricing ask & pilot constraints

Internal — forwarding the thread. Key asks from LedgerBox:
- Wants 3-week pilot + 1-week validation; procurement wants a monthly run-rate estimate.
- Openness to 4-bit quant but will gate on small eval set.

Initial thinking: recommend offering pilot at a 35% discount to list for the first 3 weeks (covers infra + SME time) with a clear min-cost floor in the SOW. Target unit-cost we want to achieve in pilot: ~0.00065 USD/token (post-quant/ batching) to justify expansion.

Please review the attached pricing-model-proposal.xlsx and let me know whether we can approve the discount and the minimum commitment. Also flag any compliance blockers for their VPC/KMS notes — Monica, can you confirm SOC2 evidence we should send ahead of kickoff?

Thanks,
Neha

Attachment referenced: pricing-model-proposal.xlsx
